name: Hornero Agenda
description: Agenda 3.0 on Hornero Signal: a desktop widget of date facts (day, ISO week, quarter, day of year, days remaining) with a year partition bar, from the shared time provider. Dates only; no events source.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Shorter footnote so it is not clipped at the bottom of the widget.

PluginKit 3 desktop widget on Hornero Signal: host-owned frame, position and size (sizeClass and showOnDesktop settings removed); day readout, ISO week/quarter/day-of-year readouts and a year partition bar with a dimension line.
Popover actions use the native full-width UiActionRow (shell 1.2.79 PluginKit) instead of small buttons.

Desktop Widgets 2.0 (#32): manifest v2 with the desktop surface redeclared on the same entrypoint, read-only Desktop.position slot and display shown in a host-owned popover, persisted compact/standard/wide size class and hide-with-restore visibility as typed settings (defaults standard/visible, so 2.0 content is unchanged), and reset for size and visibility. Moving stays in Control Center: PluginKit has no slot setter.

Time and Agenda 2.0: the 1.x date facts as labelled metrics plus quarter, ISO week-year, days remaining in the month and a year-progress bar, locale-correct dates and numbers, typed row settings with 1.x defaults and Argentine Spanish catalog. No events are shown: PluginKit has no calendar data source.
Desktop widget showing weekday, day and month, ISO week number, day of year and days remaining in the year, computed with pure Date math from PluginKit Time.

showIsoWeek.description: Show the ISO week and week-year row (the 1.x behaviour).

showYearProgress.description: Show the elapsed fraction of the year as a progress bar.
